item.title: Travis Kelce Joins Chris Lake, Who Remixed Taylor Swift’s ‘Opalite,’ on Stage in L.A.
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to the latest music news, where we dive into the hottest trends and events in the industry. I'm your host, and today we're talking about a night to remember at Chris Lake's L.A. Historic Park show.
[Cut to music clip from Chris Lake's show]
Host: Over 20,000 people gathered at the Los Angeles State Historic Park for the sold-out event, co-produced by Goldenvoice and Framework. And one special guest caught everyone's attention - NFL star Travis Kelce, who's engaged to none other than Taylor Swift.
[Cut to clip of Travis Kelce on stage]
Host: Kelce, a tight end for the Kansas City Chiefs, was spotted vibing to the beat and even took the mic beside Chris Lake. He was joined by teammates and friends at a VIP table, and from the looks of it, he had the time of his life.
[Cut to music clip from Chris Lake's remix of "Opalite"]
Host: You might know that Chris Lake has a musical connection to Taylor Swift - he remixed her single "Opalite" back in January. And it's no surprise that Kelce was a fan of Lake's work, even telling him that his 2025 album "Chemistry" was a favorite.
[Cut to clip of Taylor Swift's "Opalite" original version]
Host: Lake spoke to Billboard about the remix, saying it was a challenge to merge the pop vibe with his own club-ready beats. But the result is a hauntingly emotive track that's definitely worth a listen.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today, folks. If you're a fan of Chris Lake, Taylor Swift, or just great music in general, be sure to check out his remix of "Opalite" and stay tuned for more updates on the music scene. Thanks for tuning in!
